title: 5 extensions Chrome ai cũng nên cài ngay — làm việc nhanh hơn 300%
script: Bạn đang dùng Chrome mỗi ngày 8 tiếng mà không cài 5 extension này? Bạn đang lãng phí 3 tiếng mỗi ngày. Auto Refresh Plus tự động reload trang. Momentum biến tab mới thành dashboard cá nhân. Grammarly sửa lỗi tiếng Anh ngay trong browser. Notion Web Clipper lưu bài viết siêu nhanh. Và extension quan trọng nhất: Bitwarden — quản lý password bảo mật cao, miễn phí. Đây là bộ công cụ tối thiểu mà mọi người dùng Chrome 2026 đều cần.
prompt_for_hailuo: Modern browser window exploding open with 5 colorful glowing extension icons bursting outward in slow motion [Close up browser explosion]. Each icon floating in its own neon-colored orb — blue, purple, green, orange, red [Slow motion orb reveal]. Hands typing rapidly on keyboard with colorful light trails from each extension [Overhead tracking shot]. Final wide shot of all 5 orbs orbiting a glowing Chrome logo in perfect formation [Wide establishing shot]. Dark modern tech office, neon glow, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk productivity vibes, 9:16 portrait.
thumbnail_idea: 5 glowing neon orbs orbiting Chrome logo, cyberpunk browser explosion
visual_scene: A modern browser window suddenly explodes open with dramatic force, 5 colorful glowing extension icons bursting outward in cinematic slow motion — each icon surrounded by its own distinct neon-colored orb (blue, purple, green, orange, red). Close up captures each orb spinning and expanding. Then each orb settles into its own orbit around a massive glowing Chrome logo that materializes center frame. Overhead tracking shot shows hands flying across keyboard with colorful light trails streaming from each extension, productivity energy visible in the air. The 5 orbs complete a perfect orbital formation around the Chrome logo — blue below, purple left, green right, orange top, red accent — all pulsing in sync. Dark modern tech office with neon glow reflecting off monitors. Volumetric cyberpunk lighting. Portrait 9:16 framing throughout.
negative_prompt: generic anime or cartoon style, animated characters, distorted hands or fingers, blurry or low resolution output, text overlays or captions, logos or watermarks, still or static frame, landscape orientation, bright daylight scene, sunny outdoor setting, warm cozy home interior, cartoon cute robot design
specific_details: Browser window exploding open with 5 glowing extension icons in neon orbs (blue, purple, green, orange, red) bursting outward in slow motion, each orb settling into orbital formation around a glowing Chrome logo, hands typing rapidly with colorful light trails streaming from extensions, dark modern tech office, neon glow, volumetric cyberpunk lighting, portrait 9:16.
